questions.question: Mumbai tiffin men are never making mistake, very famous, foreign university is studying them. But one day they make mistake. Wife is cooking very nice food so husband loves her again, but food goes to old uncle who is retiring from office. Uncle eats everything and sends back empty box. Wife is happy, then confused. Now they are writing letters inside tiffin, every day. Then they decide to meet in café. Uncle comes, sees she is young, feels he is old, and does not go. Film ends. Nobody tells us anything. Very rude.

questions.question: Old Bengali father has only one subject: his stomach. Morning, evening, dinner table, in front of guests: stomach. Daughter is angry all the time but she loves him. Father wants to go Kolkata but will not sit in aeroplane, so they go by car, and taxi company owner has to drive himself because no driver will go with this family. Full road trip is about potty.
